Sectors

The shelves we already supply

  • OverviewBoth channels at a glance: shared warehouses, separate commercial teams
  • RetailWe buy your stock and sell it into supermarket, drugstore and convenience chains
  • GroceryAmbient and chilled food and drink lines we buy outright and replenish weekly
  • Health & BeautySkincare, haircare and cosmetics into drugstore chains and independent pharmacies
  • ConvenienceSmall orders to symbol groups, forecourts and independents on a shared route
  • Private labelWe match a chain's own-brand brief to a producer and buy the run ourselves
  • DentalSmall repeat orders into practices, clinics and laboratories, tracked by lot and expiry
  • Practices & clinicsSingle-pack orders, weekly calls and delivery to the surgery door
  • LaboratoriesDiscs, alloys and consumables held in stock and delivered to the bench with lot records

Distribution(2)

Distribution

From the factory gate to the shelf edge

  • OverviewWe buy the stock, hold it, get it onto shelves and report what sells
  • Chain listingsWe prepare the submission, take the buyer meeting and buy the opening order
  • Stock & deliveryOne delivery into our bay; we own it from there, store it and deliver weekly
  • Shelf executionField teams correct facings, rebuild displays and photograph every store call
  • Sell-out visibilityWeekly rate of sale per chain and SKU, with weeks of cover and batch records
  • Returns & recallsCollected on the delivery round, graded at our hub, recalls traced by batch
